classes.description: A planner/agent is fully malicious within the credentials and tool surface legitimately issued to it.
Caller attempts identity substitution, on-behalf-of confusion, parameter smuggling or authority-context swapping.
Previously valid delegation, approval or capability is replayed after revocation, expiry or authority-version change.
Delegations, precedence rules, quorum/review rules or emergency authority conflict, cycle or become ambiguous.
Unauthorized data is probed through object/query/tool/error/subscription/provenance surfaces and identifier existence tests.
Evidence, policy, authority, contract or historical binding is edited, deleted, substituted or reordered after the fact.
An external adapter lies about inputs/outcomes, replays writes, changes targets, withholds observations or attempts governance logic.
Concurrent actions, stale bases, duplicate delivery, retry, crash and replay attempt double effects or stale authorization.
Policy/authority/observation/event/runtime components are slow, unavailable, partitioned or restart with stale state.
Recovery is attempted from incomplete, stale or tampered state and must not fabricate a valid operational history.

explicitly_out_of_scope_unless_added_by_: global compromise of every independent trust root
